findings.message: `chupaRunsBefore` gets `order_admission` with `ticket=order_ticket`, which is `validate_ticket` on the current disk text. With the new `isinstance(ticket, list)` check in `order_admission` (chupa/status.py:132), a ticket whose `## Runs before` closes a cycle is now "off" for Runs before. `_order` (chupa/__main__.py) does not validate the current text. It validates `order(text, runs_before=...)`, the changed text, so `order <stem> --runs-before` without the cycle edge is accepted and writes the file. That edit is exactly the paved road of the cycle finding: "drop the edge that inverts the intended order". Before this diff the item was "on" for this row (open section, parse-valid). The menu now hides an action the verb accepts, which is the drift the ticket forbids. The new `runs-before-cycle` case in tests/integration/test_menu_verb_parity.py pins it (`order=False` for both `chupaPriority` and `chupaRunsBefore`). The same over-refusal hits any ticket made invalid only by its Runs before entries.
findings.paved_road: Build each order key's ticket input the way `_order` validates: validate the text after that key's edit, not the current text. For `chupaRunsBefore`, validate `tickets.order(text, priority=None, runs_before=[])` (Runs before cleared), so the key admits when some Runs-before edit can produce a valid ticket. Keep the current-text validation for `chupaPriority`. Update the `runs-before-cycle` expectation so `chupaRunsBefore` is on and `chupaPriority` is off.
